name: template-build-checks
body: When the project's templates are loaded (startup and reload), the registry rejects: template reference cycles; a section declaration accepting a template that lives in `templates/slides/` (directory-kind check — sections accept only templates under `templates/sections/`); a slide template (under `templates/slides/`) used as a field type; a template name present in both `slides/` and `sections/` (cross-kind name uniqueness); a required-body template used as a field type; use of the reserved `_format` suffix or `notes`/`body`/`deck`/`slide` names as declared fields/sections; references to undefined templates; and example slides that fail validation. These are reported as templates errors (step 4/7 of templates-dir-validation), path-qualified to the offending `template.yaml`/`example.md`, and are distinct from deck (slide) errors.
